correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the 12-vertex 18-edge [5,−5]^6 Franklin graph, enumerated 107 simple cycles with length histogram (3,20,24,48,12) at (4,6,8,10,12), and exhaustively found 19 vertex-disjoint pairs (3,12,4). The unordered deleted-product cubical model gives (C0,C1,C2)=(66,180,117) and signed ∂2 whose independent modular ranks are 108 mod101 and 107 mod2; these do NOT by themselves assert integral torsion. Independent integral product-torus construction verifies zero boundary. The selected nine columns with indices (0,1,2,4,6,8,12,13,14) and nine square rows (0,2,4,7,13,15,17,39,41) have determinant +1; together with rank≤9 from the 108 modular pivots, their lattice must be the full integral kernel. Recomputed type lattice ranks 3/6/4 and union ranks 6/7/9; exact maximal Smith factors are units, proving primitive partial lattices and torsion-free quotients. Six square–hexagon plus three hexagon–hexagon tori give a basis; the quotient by square–hexagon has rank three, forcing three hexagon–hexagon classes. Source verifier includes graph-automorphism orbit enumeration, but a full independent 48-automorphism check was not needed for the lattice conclusion.
residual_risks: A finite 12-vertex exact computation: no claimed theorem for general nonplanar graphs or arbitrary particle number.
Integral H1 of the configuration space was not computed.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a canonical small symmetric nonplanar cubic graph, so its integral two-particle product-cycle generators are natural to understand. Classifying which geometrically distinguished lengths generate the full H2 lattice—especially a sharp minimum of three hexagon–hexagon classes and torsion-free partial quotients—is a precise structural question not implied by the abstract rank. The exact 19-torus finite certificate is a complete natural classification of that object, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
residual_risks: The result is restricted to one graph and two particles; a broad graph-family extension is not asserted or necessary for the finite structural statement.

final_claim: For unordered two-point configurations of the Franklin graph F, H2 is Z^9 and the 19 vertex-disjoint cycle product tori have length types (4,4),(4,6),(6,6) with counts 3,12,4 and span ranks 3,6,4. The (4,4) lattice lies integrally within (4,6); (4,6)+(6,6)=H2. All partial quotient groups are torsion-free; any all-product-torus integral basis needs at least three (6,6) tori and six (4,6) plus three (6,6) attain this.
